sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "compliancecase"."transref" AS e, "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, AVG((CAST(("compliancecase"."modelconf" - "compliancecase"."risksc") AS REAL) / "compliancecase"."risksc")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "compliancecase" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "compliancecase"."transref"  GROUP BY "compliancecase"."transref", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"
quantities: compliancecase.relative difference of model confidence from compliance risk score
why: (model confidence - compliance risk score) / compliance risk score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of model confidence from compliance risk score per transactionrecord within transactionrecord.ordertypedist
share of the all total of number of compliancecase records (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
